AI Engineer – Computer Vision & Sensor Fusion

Europe

AI/ML • SpaceTech • DeepTech


For one of our clients, we’re looking for an AI Engineer to build real-world AI systems for automated inspection, anomaly detection and intelligent quality control.


This is a hands-on engineering role working at the intersection of Machine Learning, Computer Vision and Sensor Fusion, developing AI solutions that operate directly within industrial and production environments.


What you’ll work on

You’ll design, develop and deploy AI systems that combine data from cameras, LiDAR, laser sensors and other industrial sensing technologies.

Your work will cover the complete AI pipeline — from data acquisition and feature engineering through model development, validation and deployment into real production environments.


Typical projects will include:

• Computer vision for automated inspection and quality control

• Deep learning and CNN-based vision models

• Anomaly detection, including approaches such as EfficientAD

• Multi-sensor and sensor fusion systems

• Processing camera, LiDAR and laser sensor data

• Data analysis and feature engineering

• Integration of AI models with industrial automation systems

• Building reliable, production-ready ML pipelines

• Turning model outputs into real-time operational decisions


Core skills

We’re particularly interested in experience with:

Machine Learning • Deep Learning • Computer Vision • Sensor Fusion • Anomaly Detection • Python • SQL • NoSQL


Experience with some of the following would also be valuable:

MATLAB • Simulink • LabVIEW • Industrial Automation • Data Science • Feature Engineering


What we're looking for

You’ll be a strong fit if you enjoy taking AI beyond experimentation and putting it into real-world systems.


You should be comfortable working across the full lifecycle — understanding sensor data, developing and testing models, integrating multiple data sources and deploying solutions that need to operate reliably in industrial environments.


Experience with manufacturing, automated inspection, robotics, aerospace, SpaceTech, industrial AI or other DeepTech environments would be particularly relevant.


The opportunity

This is a chance to work on AI where the output isn't simply a prediction on a screen — it directly influences physical processes.


You’ll help build systems that detect defects, identify anomalies, improve quality and automate complex inspection processes, combining advanced AI with real-world engineering.
